description: Central Province Provincial Council - Notice of appointment Mr. R. M. D. Herath as a member of the Director Board of the Central Province Road Development Authority
reasoning: This gazette names a specific individual (Mr. R. M. D. Herath) and provides his appointment details (Member of the Director Board of the Central Province Road Development Authority).
